title: Distance, Speed, and Fuel
description:
A car travels 450 km at an average speed of 90 km/h and gets 12 km per liter of fuel. Fuel costs $1.45 per liter. Calculate and print the travel time in hours and minutes, the fuel used, and the total fuel cost. Round fuel used and cost to 2 decimal places.

**Expected output:**
```
Distance: 450 km
Speed: 90 km/h
Travel time: 5 hours, 0 minutes
Fuel used: 37.5 liters
Fuel cost: $54.38
```
starterCode:
# Write your code here
distance = 450
speed = 90
kmpl = 12
fuel_price = 1.45
expectedOutput:
Distance: 450 km
Speed: 90 km/h
Travel time: 5 hours, 0 minutes
Fuel used: 37.5 liters
Fuel cost: $54.38
hint: time_hours = distance / speed. fuel = distance / kmpl. cost = fuel * fuel_price.
